_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Flight in Distress#000.src: The inscription on the gravestone reads "Here lies our great founder, Tisaun Sodeta. May he guide us through the endless fight."
Flight in Distress#000.dst: Mezar taşındaki yazıt şöyle diyor: "Burada büyük kurucumuz Tisaun Sodeta yatıyor. Bitmeyen savaşta bize yol göstersin."
Flight in Distress#000.speaker:
Gravestone
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Flight in Distress#001.src: An unsettlingly powerful energy seems to blanket the area. There is potential here for...something. But not yet...
Flight in Distress#001.dst: Tedirgin edici derecede güçlü bir enerji bölgeyi kaplamış gibi. Burada... bir şey için potansiyel var. Ama henüz değil...
Flight in Distress#001.speaker:
Gravestone
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Flight in Distress#002.src: No worries, have a nice day!

Flight in Distress#003.src: Seems like you are already part of my division! There is nothing left that I can do for you at the moment.
Flight in Distress#003.dst: Görünüşe göre zaten benim bölümümdesin! Şu an senin için yapabileceğim başka bir şey yok.

Flight in Distress#004.src: Hi! Welcome to the {p}! How can I help?
Flight in Distress#004.dst: Selam! {p} bölgesine hoş geldin! Nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?
Flight in Distress#004.speaker:
Silverbull Rank Expert
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Flight in Distress#005.src: Don't let the name intimidate you, put your head to it and you'll find your way just fine!
Flight in Distress#005.dst: Adı gözünü korkutmasın, kafa yorarsan yolunu gayet iyi bulursun!
Flight in Distress#005.speaker:
Silverbull Rank Expert
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Flight in Distress#006.src: Ranking up is super simple! All you have to do is complete Lootruns!
Flight in Distress#006.dst: Rütbe atlamak çok basit! Tek yapman gereken Lootrun tamamlamak!
Flight in Distress#006.speaker:
Silverbull Rank Expert
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Flight in Distress#007.src: The more challenges you complete, the more experience you gain at the end!
Flight in Distress#007.dst: Ne kadar çok mücadele tamamlarsan, sonunda o kadar çok deneyim kazanırsın!
Flight in Distress#007.speaker:
Silverbull Rank Expert
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Flight in Distress#008.src: And that's all there is to it! Let me know if you want to know more.
Flight in Distress#008.dst: Hepsi bu kadar! Daha fazlasını öğrenmek istersen bana söyle.

Flight in Distress#009.src: Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Flight in Distress#009.dst: Gavel Pasaportunu Hava Gemisi Memuru'na götür: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Flight in Distress#010.src: Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
Flight in Distress#010.dst: İyi günler, asker! Bugün bizimle mi uçacaksın?
Flight in Distress#010.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#011.src: May I see your passport please?
Flight in Distress#011.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#012.src: It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
Flight in Distress#012.dst: Biraz tozlu! Çok eski görünüyor ama fotoğraf sana benziyor.
Flight in Distress#012.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#013.src: Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
Flight in Distress#013.dst: Her şey yolunda görünüyor, gemiye bin, umarım keyifli bir yolculuk geçirirsin.
Flight in Distress#013.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#015.src: Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
Flight in Distress#015.dst: Lütfen yerlerinizde kalın, yolcular. Birazdan kalkıyoruz!
Flight in Distress#015.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#016.src: Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
Flight in Distress#016.dst: Kayıp çocuk hakkında Kaptan Ackbar ile konuş.

Flight in Distress#017.src: Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
Flight in Distress#017.dst: Yolcuların dikkatine. Gemide kayıp bir kişi bildirildi. Aramaya yardım etmek isteyen gönüllüler varsa lütfen köprüye gelip kaptanla konuşsun.
Flight in Distress#017.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#018.src: This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee waiting at your cabin.
Flight in Distress#018.dst: Kalkış sırasında bu alan yolculara kapalıdır. Yolcu güvertelerine çık, kamarında seni bir görevli bekliyor olacak.
Flight in Distress#018.speaker: Ship Crew

Flight in Distress#019.src: I hope I do not get nauseous...
Flight in Distress#019.speaker: Passenger Jeremy

Flight in Distress#020.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#020.dst: Selamlar, genç maceracı. Gözlüklerimi görmedin, değil mi?
Flight in Distress#020.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#021.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#021.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#022.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#022.dst: İyi günler, asker! Uçuş boyunca kalacağın yer burası. Bizimle keyifli bir yolculuk dilerim!
Flight in Distress#022.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#023.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#023.dst: Yapacak başka işin yoksa yolculuk boyunca burada uyuyabilirsin!
Flight in Distress#023.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#024.src: The food they serve here is dreadful! As if it were meant for beasts they transport below deck.
Flight in Distress#024.dst: Burada verdikleri yemek berbat! Sanki alt güvertede taşıdıkları hayvanlar için yapılmış.
Flight in Distress#024.speaker: Passenger Casula

Flight in Distress#025.src: *Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
Flight in Distress#025.dst: *Hıçkırık*... Çocuğumu gördün mü? Kamaramızdaydık, sonra birden ortadan kayboldu!
Flight in Distress#025.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#026.src: I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
Flight in Distress#026.dst: Kuzeyden büyük bir geminin yaklaştığını duydum. Giriş güvertesinden gördüm. Ne yapıyorlar acaba.
Flight in Distress#026.speaker: Sub-engineer Akot

Flight in Distress#027.src: Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
Flight in Distress#027.dst: Kayıp çocuğu aramak için gönüllü olmaya mı geldin?
Flight in Distress#027.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#028.src: We only just to set off and there is already an incident.
Flight in Distress#028.dst: Daha yeni yola çıktık ve şimdiden bir olay var.
Flight in Distress#028.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#029.src: His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
Flight in Distress#029.dst: Annesi, oğlunun gemiye bindikten kısa süre sonra kaybolduğunu bildirdi.
Flight in Distress#029.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#030.src: Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
Flight in Distress#030.dst: Bana sorarsan kötü ebeveynlik. Neyse, çocuğu bulmalıyız.
Flight in Distress#030.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#031.src: Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
Flight in Distress#031.dst: Elimizde hiçbir ipucu olmadığından, yolculardan bilgi almak en iyisi olabilir.
Flight in Distress#031.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#032.src: Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
Flight in Distress#032.dst: Çoğu yemek salonunda ya da dinlenme salonunda olur.
Flight in Distress#032.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#033.src: Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
Flight in Distress#033.dst: Yardımın için çok teşekkürler; umarım çocuğu çabucak bulursun.
Flight in Distress#033.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#034.src: Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
Flight in Distress#034.dst: Yolcularla konuşarak kayıp çocuğun nerede olduğunu bulmaya çalış.

Flight in Distress#035.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
Flight in Distress#035.dst: Hey! Şu uzaktaki gemiye bak. Neredeyse yola çıktığımızdan beri gemimizi takip ediyor.
Flight in Distress#035.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#036.src: I know I shouldn't be down here but...
Flight in Distress#036.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#037.src: I love airships, and I have never seen one like that.
Flight in Distress#037.dst: Hava gemilerine bayılırım, ve öylesini hiç görmedim.
Flight in Distress#037.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#039.src: Okay then, I will head back right now!
Flight in Distress#039.dst: Tamam o zaman, hemen geri dönüyorum!
Flight in Distress#039.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#041.src: Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
Flight in Distress#041.dst: Çocuğumu bulduğun için çok teşekkür ederim! Yolculuğun geri kalanında yanımdan hiç ayrılmayacak.
Flight in Distress#041.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#042.src: I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
Flight in Distress#042.dst: Az önce sizi öyle endişelendirdiğim için özür dilerim...
Flight in Distress#042.speaker: Found Child

Flight in Distress#043.src: Hello again, did you find him?
Flight in Distress#043.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#044.src: How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
Flight in Distress#044.dst: Oraya nasıl inmiş?! Orada nöbetçi olması gerekiyordu!
Flight in Distress#044.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#045.src: Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
Flight in Distress#045.dst: Onu bulduğun için çok teşekkürler. Tek gönüllü sendin.
Flight in Distress#045.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#046.src: Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
Flight in Distress#046.dst: Umarım yolculuktaki tek aksilik bu olur.
Flight in Distress#046.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#047.src: What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
Flight in Distress#047.dst: Tanrı aşkına o da neydi? Mürettebat, rapor verin!
Flight in Distress#047.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#048.src: Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
Flight in Distress#048.dst: Efendim! Motorlarımızdan biri patladı! O taraftaki bütün itiş gücünü kaybettik.
Flight in Distress#048.speaker: Airship Crewmember

Flight in Distress#049.src: Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
Flight in Distress#049.dst: Kahretsin! İki motor olmadan olduğumuz yerde çakılı kaldık.
Flight in Distress#049.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#050.src: Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Flight in Distress#050.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#051.src: Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
Flight in Distress#051.dst: Asker, makine dairesindeki Mühendis'e git ve yeniden yola çıkmamız için yapabileceğin bir şey var mı bak.
Flight in Distress#051.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#052.src: Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
Flight in Distress#052.dst: Mühendisin yardım etmen için sana verecek bir işi var mı bak.

Flight in Distress#053.src: You must be the 'uman the captain done told me.
Flight in Distress#053.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#054.src: We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
Flight in Distress#054.dst: Aşağıda epey bi' durum var valla.
Flight in Distress#054.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#055.src: I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
Flight in Distress#055.dst: Burda kalıp m'torlara bakmam lazım, yoksa kız kendine zarar verebilir.
Flight in Distress#055.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#056.src: If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
Flight in Distress#056.dst: Yardım etmek istiyosan 'nsan, halatlardan yukarı çık da pervanelere bi' göz at.
Flight in Distress#056.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#057.src: Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
Flight in Distress#057.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#058.src: If'n they're stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
Flight in Distress#058.dst: Durmuşlarsa kapalı olan şalterlere bas yeter.
Flight in Distress#058.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#059.src: Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
Flight in Distress#059.dst: İşin bitince buraya gel. Burda kalıp kızı serin tutmam lazım.
Flight in Distress#059.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#060.src: Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
Flight in Distress#060.dst: Hava gemisinin motorlarındaki sorunu bul ve düzelt. Motorlar köprüden çıkılan balonun tepesinde.

Flight in Distress#061.src: In event of shut-down, maitenence must be performed.
Flight in Distress#061.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#062.src: Worker must restart all wooden switches before engine overheats.
Flight in Distress#062.dst: Çalışan, motor aşırı ısınmadan önce tüm ahşap şalterleri yeniden çalıştırmalıdır.
Flight in Distress#062.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#063.src: DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Flight in Distress#063.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#064.src: Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
Flight in Distress#064.dst: Mühendis Eric'e motorları tamir ettiğini bildir.

Flight in Distress#065.src: Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
Flight in Distress#065.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#066.src: I couldn't have dun this without ye.
Flight in Distress#066.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#067.src: You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
Flight in Distress#067.dst: Sen kamarana dön de biraz dinlen. Senin gibi bi' yolcunun mürettebata yardım etmesi gerekmez.
Flight in Distress#067.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#068.src: I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
Flight in Distress#068.dst: Umarım yolculuğunun kalanı iyi geçer. Kap'tana haber vereyim de kızı sonuna kadar açıp bizi yeniden yola çıkarsın.
Flight in Distress#068.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#072.src: All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff report to stations!
Flight in Distress#072.dst: Tüm personel görev yerlerine! Bu bir tatbikat değil! Tüm personel görev yerlerine!
Flight in Distress#072.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#073.src: Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
Flight in Distress#073.dst: Alt güverteyi keşfet ve patlamaya neyin sebep olduğunu bul.

Flight in Distress#074.src: Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
Flight in Distress#074.dst: Dayan be koca kız, yaparsın sen bunu!
Flight in Distress#074.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#075.src: Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
Flight in Distress#075.dst: Beyler, gemiyi sabit tutun. Bunu hâlâ atlatabiliriz! Sadece bizi takip etmelerini durdurmamız gerek.
Flight in Distress#075.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#077.src: Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Flight in Distress#077.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#078.src: Send more in! They can't get all of us!
Flight in Distress#078.dst: Daha fazlasını gönderin! Hepimizi alt edemezler!
Flight in Distress#078.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#079.src: The rest of you all, get in here!
Flight in Distress#079.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#081.src: I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
Flight in Distress#081.dst: Kavga sesi mi duydum? Orada biri var mı? Hücredeyim!
Flight in Distress#081.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#083.src: I heard fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
Flight in Distress#083.dst: Yukarıda kavga sesleri duydum, aferin! O yağmacıların hak ettiklerini bulduğunu görmek yaşlı kalbimi ısıtır.
Flight in Distress#083.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#084.src: I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
Flight in Distress#084.dst: Eskiden bütün Gavel'in en büyük çilingiriydim! Ne yazık ki her yerde tanınırdım.
Flight in Distress#084.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#085.src: These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
Flight in Distress#085.dst: Bu alçaklar yıllar önce beni yakaladı ve baskınları için yüzlerce anahtar yaptırdı.
Flight in Distress#085.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#086.src: I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
Flight in Distress#086.dst: Artık çok yaşlıyım, ama bu dünyadan göçmeden önce onların yenildiğini görmeyi çok isterim.
Flight in Distress#086.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#087.src: My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
Flight in Distress#087.dst: Anahtar yapma aletlerim koridorun sonunda, merdivenin arkasında duruyor. Onlarla Kraliçe'nin odasına girmenin bir yolunu yapabilirsin.
Flight in Distress#087.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#088.src: Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
Flight in Distress#088.dst: Nasıl yapılacağını görmek için anahtar deliğine bak yeter. Bol şans!
Flight in Distress#088.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#089.src: Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
Flight in Distress#089.dst: Skyraider Kraliçesi'ne ulaşmak için anahtarı yap.

Flight in Distress#090.src: So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
Flight in Distress#090.dst: Demek gemime öylece gelebileceğini sanıyorsun, ha?
Flight in Distress#090.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#091.src: Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
Flight in Distress#091.dst: Tayfamı öldürmek mi? Yağmamı bölmek mi?
Flight in Distress#091.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#092.src: I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
Flight in Distress#092.dst: Senin gibi 'sorunlar'la nasıl başa çıkılacağını bilirim!
Flight in Distress#092.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#093.src: Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
Flight in Distress#093.dst: Skyraider Kraliçesi ile savaş ve onun kişisel hazinelerinden birini yanına al.

Flight in Distress#094.src: Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#094.dst: Gemiden kaç ve Kaptan Ackbar ile konuş.

Flight in Distress#095.src: Wow, You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
Flight in Distress#095.dst: Vay, bir skyraider istilasını tek başına püskürttün.
Flight in Distress#095.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#096.src: And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
Flight in Distress#096.dst: Üstelik bir yolcusun! İyi ki yaptın...
Flight in Distress#096.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#097.src: We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
Flight in Distress#097.dst: Bu gemide hiçbir savunmamız yok. Biz sivil bir taşıyıcıyız.
Flight in Distress#097.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#098.src: What is this? A ring from the queen? It looks valuable. You should keep it.
Flight in Distress#098.dst: Bu ne? Kraliçeden bir yüzük mü? Değerli görünüyor. Sende kalsın.
Flight in Distress#098.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#099.src: I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
Flight in Distress#099.dst: Sana nasıl teşekkür edeceğimi hâlâ bilmiyorum... Sana çok şey borçluyuz.
Flight in Distress#099.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#100.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
Flight in Distress#100.dst: Dur! Buldum! {p} ile {p} arasında ücretsiz yolculuk yapabilirsin!
Flight in Distress#100.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#101.src: A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Flight in Distress#101.dst: Calo adında özel bir hava gemisi sahibi bana büyük bir borçlu.
Flight in Distress#101.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#102.src: I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
Flight in Distress#102.dst: Ona anlaşmayı anlatırım. Tek yapman gereken gemisine binmek, o da seni gidip getirir!
Flight in Distress#102.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#103.src: Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
Flight in Distress#103.dst: Ha, bir de güzel bir para ödülü alacaksın. Yüzüğü de yolda zarar görmesin diye ona bizzat göndereceğim, orada teslim alırsın.
Flight in Distress#103.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#104.src: Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
Flight in Distress#104.dst: Giriş güvertesine in yeter, {p} Hava Üssü'ne varmak üzereyiz.
Flight in Distress#104.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#105.dst: Bize yardım ettiğin için gerçekten teşekkürler!
Flight in Distress#105.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#106.src: Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
Flight in Distress#106.dst: Giriş güvertesine in ve gemiden ayrıl.

Flight in Distress#107.src: Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.
Flight in Distress#107.dst: {p} limanındaki küçük geminin yanında Calo ile konuş.

Flight in Distress#108.src: Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
Flight in Distress#108.dst: Selam. Ackbar'ın bahsettiği İnsan sen olmalısın.
Flight in Distress#108.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#109.src: I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#109.dst: Gemide yaptıklarını duydum, çok takdire değer. Şansına, Ackbar'a borçluyum.
Flight in Distress#109.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#110.src: I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
Flight in Distress#110.dst: Ne zaman istersen seni {p} ile {p} arasında götürüp getiririm.
Flight in Distress#110.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#111.src: All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#111.dst: Tek yapman gereken gemime binmek. Ha, bu da Ackbar'dan.
Flight in Distress#111.speaker: Calo
